column6: Both paragraphs convey the same core message about the importance of a solid system and structure for effective functioning, particularly in the context of living as a healthy Christian with a strong foundation in doctrine.
column7: For things to function effectively, a solid system and structure are essential. Without them, dysfunction and chaos can easily arise. This is why establishing a strong foundation in doctrine is crucial for fully living as a healthy Christian.
column8: To run things effectively, a robust system and structure are absolutely essential. Without these, disorder and chaos can easily arise. That is why, to live fully as a healthy Christian, it is crucial to lay a strong foundation in doctrine.
